title: How Home is arranged
question: Home has three jobs: find an invoice, show how a review works, and open INV0021439 in one click. The paper, ink, and moss already in the app stay. Pick the arrangement.

options.label: Work slip
options.lineage: one open work item on a reviewer's desk
options.thesis: The verified case is the first work item. Search is how a different invoice comes in.
materials: priority held in ember until opened
options.viewport: Top bar with Home. A search across the width. One row for INV0021439 with its priority and Open. Under it, a short strip: signals, ownership path, human decision.
options.risk: Someone who already has an invoice id has to look past the demo row to reach search.

options.label: Desk blotter
options.lineage: search as the desk, the demo file clipped beside it
options.thesis: Search owns the desk. The demo case sits beside it, and the review steps sit underneath.
options.viewport: Top bar with Home. A large search on the left, the demo case as a file on the right, three steps of a review across the bottom.
options.risk: Search and the demo file can compete, so the first action is less obvious.

options.label: Cited record
options.lineage: an evidence brief with notes in the margin
options.thesis: The demo case is written as an evidence brief. Margin notes say what each part of a review is for.
options.viewport: Home and search in the header. The center is the cited demo record. The right margin holds short notes keyed to those lines.
options.risk: It can read as a document before it reads as a place to start work.
